headline: Stlican Shelf Stirs as Callahans Passage Bleeds On
war_summary: Three hours on, the map of motion has shifted. Stlican Shelf, dormant through the afternoon, has posted the freshest ownership action of any region, Breaker Town its busiest post, while the Nevish Line follows close behind with recent movement at Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother. Weathered Expanse and Linn Mercy, the last edition's lead stories, have logged no flag changes since early evening, yet their casualty ledgers still climb — over a thousand Colonial and some fifteen hundred Warden losses in two hours at Weathered Expanse, though the hourly tolls on both fronts are cooling. Callahans Passage continues to bleed heaviest of all, roughly 1,900 Colonial and 1,000 Warden casualties in the same span, its pace eased further, and not a base there has changed hands. Godcrofts retains the day's largest flag ledger at forty-six actions, with Palantine Berm second at thirty and still showing sharp fighting despite an afternoon lull in transfers; Marban Hollow and Stonecradle have rested longest. Fishermans Row, briefly the freshest front, has fallen silent, while Farranac Coast shows a handful of actions about Transient Valley. The prize stands at thirty-four victory towns, and neither banner yet claims the war.
